_meta.purpose: Brand quality ledger. tier A = buy blind, B = buy after checking the item, C = skip. Seeded by Claude from the top ~200 brands in the catalogue by item count; Andrey corrects — his verdict always wins. Brands absent here are treated as unrated (skipped by the scorer).

Nike.note: Quality varies wildly by line; retro/premium lines good, basics mediocre

adidas.note: Same as Nike — Originals/collabs good, mainline basics thin

Replay.note: Mid-tier denim, heavily discounted everywhere — discounts are not deals

OFF WHITE.note: Hype tax; quality mid for the price even discounted

Aimé Leon Dore.note: Consistently well-made, holds value, rarely discounted deep — real deals rare and worth catching

Carhartt WIP.note: Workwear-grade fabrics, consistent sizing, benchmark for the price

New Balance.note: Made in UK/USA lines excellent; even mainline is solid

District Vision.note: Good technical running gear, steep original prices

Crocs.note: Cheap everywhere always; no scarcity, no deal

Stussy.note: Streetwear staple, good cotton weights, holds resale value

Asics.note: Best running-shoe value on the market, esp. Gel lines

Snow Peak.note: Japanese outdoor, excellent materials, rarely cheap — flag any real discount

JORDAN.note: Retro models good; check the specific silhouette

CFCL.note: Japanese knit engineering, unique product, quality consistent

Feng Chen Wang.note: Interesting design, construction varies by piece

BALENCIAGA.note: Luxury price, streetwear construction; only worth it at extreme discount

Hoka.note: Top-tier running comfort, discounts on last-season colorways are real value

ALLSAINTS.note: Decent leather, mid everything else; perma-sale pricing

VANS.note: Classics are fine and cheap; premium/Vault line is the quality one

Noah.note: ALD-adjacent NYC brand, honest construction, made in decent factories

GUCCI.note: Quality real but hype-priced; needs 60%+ off to make sense

Stone Island.note: Fabric R&D is the product; badge hype aside, garments are excellent

Lacoste.note: Piqué classics solid, rest of range ordinary

Polo Ralph Lauren.note: Core items (oxfords, knits) are benchmark quality-per-dollar on sale

Saucony.note: Running value pick, esp. Peregrine/Endorphin on discount

Gramicci.note: Climbing heritage, durable cotton, fair pricing

On.note: Comfortable but durability complaints; check the model

RICK OWENS.note: Signature construction and fabrics; mainline discounts are rare finds

Café du Cycliste.note: Premium cycling wear, real technical quality

MAISON MARGIELA.note: Mainline quality high; GAT sneakers and knits especially

EMPORIO ARMANI.note: Diffusion line, not mainline Armani quality

Fear of God Essentials.note: Oversized basics at hype markup, ordinary fabrics

Moncler.note: Down quality genuine; real discounts almost never happen — flag them

KAPITAL.note: Japanese craft denim/boro, unique product, holds value

OUR LEGACY.note: Scandi fabrics and cuts, consistent quality, sale prices are real value

Levi's.note: Premium/LVC good; mainline fine at deep discount only

ANTA.note: Chinese performance tech improving fast, esp. basketball

New Era.note: Caps are the product; fine at discount

Dries Van Noten.note: Print and fabric master; sale-season buys are the classic move

Salomon.note: Trail tech is real; XT line discounts are catches

MM6 MAISON MARGIELA.note: Diffusion Margiela — good design, lighter construction than mainline

JACQUEMUS.note: Design hype, construction mid for price

Golden Goose.note: Pre-distressed at luxury price; poor value at any discount

Converse.note: Chuck 70 and collabs worth it, basics commodity

Norse Projects.note: Scandi minimalist staples, good fabric sourcing

Brunello Cucinelli.note: Top-tier materials; any real discount is exceptional

LEMAIRE.note: Understated luxury, excellent cuts and fabrics, holds value

Autry.note: Retro court shoes, fine at discount

VIVIENNE WESTWOOD.note: Iconic design; construction varies by line

visvim.note: Obsessive Japanese craft; discounts nearly nonexistent — always flag

Patta.note: Amsterdam institution, quality blanks and collabs

ACNE STUDIOS.note: Scandi luxury, good denim and knits

Dr. Martens.note: Made in England line good; standard line quality dropped

ARKET.note: H&M group premium arm — decent basics at sale prices

Sacai.note: Hybrid construction pioneer, top Japanese quality

Y-3.note: Yohji design on adidas production; fine at discount

RICK OWENS DRKSHDW.note: Diffusion but keeps signature cuts; deals worth catching

The North Face.note: Purple Label/Japan lines A; global mainline B

C.P. Company.note: Stone Island's older sibling, same fabric culture, better prices

ALEXANDER MCQUEEN.note: Mainline strong, sneaker line is commodity at hype price

VEJA.note: Ethical sneakers, decent quality, rarely deep-discounted

RAY-BAN.note: Standard optics; only at strong discount

DIESEL.note: Glenn Martens era redeemed it; denim line worth checking

Human Made.note: Nigo's brand, Japanese production, holds value

G-SHOCK.note: Indestructible, price floor known — easy anchor

Birkenstock.note: Made in Germany, known price floor, real discounts rare

Mizuno.note: Japanese running value, underpriced vs peers

Undercover.note: Jun Takahashi, Japanese quality, collector value

TAGLIATORE.note: Italian tailoring value — real construction below big-name prices

Isabel Marant.note: French contemporary, quality mid for price

DICKIES.note: Workwear commodity — good only at low price

Belstaff.note: Moto heritage, real waxed cotton and leather

AMIRI.note: LA luxury denim, hype tax heavy
